clue.text: In favour of the sentence existing now

parts.note: for means in favour of, as in voting for a motion
taken as written
a prison sentence is time, as in doing time
being means existing, as in a human being

explanation.surface: Someone backs the current sentence, the one existing now.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means for the present moment, temporarily.

clue.text: How unsuccessful tightrope walker might deteriorate

definitions.meaning: a failing high-wire performer might literally drop off the rope

explanation.definitionFit: Literally tumble from the rope, and figuratively decline in quality or quantity.

clue.text: New word that is right for "noisier"

indicators.note: new means remade, so the letters of word are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A thesaurus entry offering a fresh word for noisier.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowdier means louder and more boisterous, a comparative like the clue word.

clue.text: Not easy to pursue this on stage?

definitions.text: Not easy to pursue this on stage?

parts.words: Not easy to pursue this on stage?
parts.note: a theatrical turn so good that the next performer struggles to match it, read literally as a show that is hard to come after

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes a superb performer or achievement that any successor will struggle to equal.

clue.text: Undisturbed, taking more than half of the drug

indicators.note: only the opening part of the word for the drug, a majority of its letters, is kept

parts.note: a tranquilliser is a calming drug

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm after swallowing most of the medicine.
explanation.walkthrough: Keep eight of the thirteen letters of TRANQUILLISER, dropping LISER.
explanation.definitionFit: Tranquil means calm, peaceful, free from agitation.

clue.text: Thousand leaving appalling dilemma for apple nymph

indicators.note: appalling suggests something dreadful, so the remaining letters are badly rearranged
the letter for thousand leaves the word dilemma

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A thousand people walk away from a terrible quandary over an apple nymph.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove one M from DILEMMA to leave DILEMA, then rearrange those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Maelids, or Meliae, were nymphs of apple trees.

clue.text: Comprehensive reporting after snowstorm

definitions.meaning: news coverage that leaves nothing out
the land after heavy snow lies under a covering like a white quilt

explanation.definitionFit: Exhaustive news reporting, and literally the quilt-like layer of snow left over the ground.

clue.text: Put in possession in new Mexico perhaps

parts.note: taken as written
New Mexico is an example of a US state

explanation.surface: Someone takes ownership of land in the new country of Mexico.
explanation.walkthrough: The lower-case 'new' hides the proper name New Mexico, one of the US states.
explanation.definitionFit: To instate is to install someone in an office or give them possession of a position.

clue.text: Sieve used with force first on cooking surface

indicators.note: first puts the letter for force at the front of the word for sieve

parts.note: g is the symbol for the force of gravity, as in g-force
a riddle is a coarse sieve for soil or gravel

explanation.surface: A sieve is pressed into use as a hob.
explanation.definitionFit: A griddle is a flat iron plate for cooking on.

clue.text: Let down container having small type

parts.note: to lower something is to let it down
a case is a box or container

explanation.surface: A box lowered to the ground holds small printed type.
explanation.walkthrough: In old print shops the small letters were kept in the lower of two type cases, hence the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Small letters, as opposed to capitals, are the minuscule forms of print.

clue.text: A ship taking top-grade palm

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
A1 written as AI means first-class, top-grade

explanation.surface: A ship takes on a cargo of first-class palm.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 is Lloyd's Register's top rating for ships; crosswords render it as the letters AI.
explanation.definitionFit: Assai is a South American palm tree, the source of acai berries.

clue.text: Where in France one gets German agreement on board

parts.note: the French word for where is ou (strictly where)
the Roman numeral for one is I
ja is the German word for yes

explanation.surface: Somewhere in France a person finds a German agreeing to come on board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Where in France' tempts a solver toward the French for yes; it is the French for where.
explanation.definitionFit: A Ouija board is a lettered tablet used at seances to spell out messages from spirits.

clue.text: Beach that's alive!

parts.note: quick is an old word for living, as in the quick and the dead
a beach is made of sand

explanation.surface: An exclamation that the shore itself has come to life.
explanation.walkthrough: Shifting wet sand that swallows things seems to be a living beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Waterlogged ground that sucks down whatever stands on it seems alive to anyone trapped in it.

clue.text: It might be needed if dart is misdirected

definitions.text: It might be needed if dart is misdirected

indicators.note: sent astray, so the letters of these three words are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A stray dart may injure someone and call for treatment.
explanation.definitionFit: Emergency treatment given on the spot would be called for if a dart hit a bystander.

clue.text: Two articles going to the north east for the goddess

parts.note: the indefinite article a and the definite article the
the indefinite article a and the definite article the

explanation.surface: Two newspaper pieces head off to the north east in search of a goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: Athene is the Greek goddess of wisdom, also spelt Athena.

clue.text: Satisfactorily contract when strongly built

parts.note: well means satisfactorily
to knit the brows is to contract them in a frown

explanation.surface: A contract is signed to everyone's satisfaction once the building is sturdy.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-knit describes a sturdy, compact physique or a tightly constructed structure.

clue.text: Jack in favour of clumsy uncouth person

indicators.note: the word for jack sits inside the word for favour

parts.note: a boon is a favour or blessing
a jack tar is a sailor, and AB (able seaman) is a sailor

explanation.surface: Jack is all for some awkward lout.
explanation.definitionFit: The ape's name is used figuratively for a coarse, oafish person.

clue.text: Support gambling

definitions.meaning: ... a horse is betting on it

explanation.definitionFit: Backing is support or endorsement, and also the act of placing a bet on a horse.

clue.text: Encourage, in good French surroundings, to produce sprouts

indicators.note: the French word for good goes around the word for encourage

parts.note: bon is French for good
to urge someone on is to encourage them

explanation.surface: In a French garden, good conditions encourage plants to sprout.
explanation.definitionFit: To burgeon is to put out buds or shoots, and so to grow rapidly.

clue.text: Person who advocates change again late

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
late can mean former, as in the late president

explanation.surface: A campaigner for change turns up late once more.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who campaigns to improve institutions or practices, a campaigner for reform.

clue.text: Drink from market in Italian capital

parts.note: a mart is a market
taken as written

indicators.note: the capital letter of Italian is its first, I

explanation.surface: A drink bought at a market in the Italian capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Italian capital' suggests Rome; it means the first letter of Italian.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is a cocktail of gin or vodka and vermouth.

clue.text: Put one's foot down again on the tyre

definitions.meaning: a tyre with fresh tread moulded on

explanation.definitionFit: To step a second time, and a remoulded tyre given a new tread.

clue.text: Five little creatures stopped short on square woven fabric

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

indicators.note: cut short at the end, so the last letter of the word for little creatures is dropped

parts.note: elves are small mythical beings
a T-square is a drawing tool, so T stands for square

explanation.surface: Five tiny fairies halt on a square of woven cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Velvet is a closely woven fabric with a short dense pile.

clue.text: NCO accepts eastern material

indicators.note: the word for the soldier takes the letter for eastern inside it

parts.note: a corporal is a non-commissioned officer

explanation.surface: A non-commissioned officer takes delivery of some cloth from the east.
explanation.definitionFit: Corporeal means physical, having a body, as opposed to spiritual.

clue.text: Bird, bemoan not redhead

indicators.note: not signals that the letter for redhead is left out

parts.note: to bemoan something is to regret it
the head of red is its first letter, R

explanation.surface: Someone laments that a bird is not a redhead.
explanation.definitionFit: An egret is a white heron, a wading bird.

clue.text: One business arrangement that's just right

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
a deal is a business agreement

explanation.surface: A single business agreement that suits everyone perfectly.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal means perfect, exactly as one would wish.

clue.text: Virginia daniels' appalling damage

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

indicators.note: appalling suggests something dreadful, so these letters are badly rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, the apostrophe giving no letter

explanation.surface: Virginia Daniels has done some shocking harm.
explanation.definitionFit: To vandalise is to wilfully damage property.

clue.text: Taken during the storm perhaps and disappeared without trace

definitions.meaning: carried away by a gale, literally blown off
the idiom for vanished completely, also the title of a famous novel and film

explanation.definitionFit: Literally swept away by a gale, and idiomatically vanished entirely, as in the famous novel title.
